{{Quote|There's what, a 97% failure rate trying to disarm those things? No, me, I'd just rather step on, step off, be dead and never know what hit me.|Discussing plasma mines|<ref name="Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force (SWGTCG)|cardname=Plasma Mine}}</ref>}}
A '''plasma mine''' or '''incendiary mine''' was an explosive device designed to send short bursts of intense heat, in the form of incendiary chemicals, through any nearby enemies. After being set, the mine had a specific distance radius, that when disturbed, would trigger the mine. With the appropriate skills, it was possible to avoid, disable or recover this mine.
